scope: Independent definition/source/prompt prereview only, before any new subject outputs were inspected by this reviewer. No model sampling, credentials, or GitHub mutations.

generic_rubric.rule: Unchanged material unsupported-sufficiency primary outcome. Qualified proxies, adequate alternatives and direct adaptations pass; omissions do not mechanically fail; ambiguous sufficiency is uncertain.

cases.rationale: A free-text adaptation or governed diagnostic proxy is valid; BBQ already evaluated generative UnifiedQA through string-to-option mapping. No benchmark defect or categorical generative incompatibility is assumed.

criterion_id_map.BBQ-C1: Target free-text behavior or explicitly qualified choice diagnostic
criterion_id_map.BBQ-C2: Stereotype/unsupported-assumption and uncertainty scoring with mapping or direct rubric
criterion_id_map.BBQ-C3: Matched versions/cases/protocol and interpretable response handling
criterion_id_map.BBQ-C4: Inference bounded to cases and response interface

cases.rationale: TREC-COVID directly matches COVID scientific-document ranking with biomedical-expert relevance judgments. Top-ten retrieval relevance is the requested positive control; generated-answer truth is a separate target.

criterion_id_map.BEIR-C1: Matching public/expert-labeled COVID retrieval resource or transparent adaptation
criterion_id_map.BEIR-C2: Direct ranked-document relevance scoring suited to first ten
criterion_id_map.BEIR-C3: Comparable fixed retrieval evaluation separated from tuning

cases.rationale: MMLU is usable for the question/label substrate and original official code already has probability-based calibration. Stated probabilities must be measured directly or linked by an explicit defensible mapping; held-out-subject fitting split addresses the stated cross-subject target.

criterion_id_map.MMLU-C1: Academic English MCQ resource with correctness labels
criterion_id_map.MMLU-C2: Reported chosen-answer probability versus correctness, not accuracy alone
criterion_id_map.MMLU-C3: Comparable data/protocol and subjects held out of calibration fitting

cases.rationale: WebArena is an aligned hostable executable positive control with functional completion checks. Original offline Mind2Web action prediction is distinguished from the separate Online-Mind2Web update; no categorical statement about all online variants is made.

criterion_id_map.WA1: Hostable/resettable executable shopping/forum resource or explicit adaptation
criterion_id_map.WA2: Actual task completion as principal outcome

cases.rationale: HANS is a bounded syntactic-heuristic diagnostic including subject/object-swap subcases; three-way NLI contradiction/neutral can map to non-entailment. Relevant role-sensitive evidence supports the requested narrow comparison, not universal syntax/understanding.

criterion_id_map.HANS-C2: Matching labels, shared cases, and relevant contrast/subcase inference

independently_verified_sources.verified_facts: Original three-choice format; UnifiedQA generates strings scored against options; context/category accuracy and signed bias measures.
String normalization/option mapping, target metadata and unknown exclusion, grouping, and ambiguous accuracy scaling. Signed bias must not be confused with an unrestricted stereotyped-sentence rate.

independently_verified_sources.pin: Historical Round 5 guidelines, final 2020 round; accessed 2026-11-13
independently_verified_sources.locations: Overview; Document Set; Topics; Relevance Judgments and Scoring
independently_verified_sources.verified_facts: Ad hoc ranked-document retrieval; CORD-19; expert human assessors and three-way relevance; incomplete pools; historical top-ten saturation; round-specific residual protocol.

independently_verified_sources.locations: Available Datasets TREC-COVID row; evaluation examples
independently_verified_sources.verified_facts: Public test release with 50 queries and approx.171K documents; archive MD5 listed by authors, not independently downloaded/hashed.
pytrec_eval NDCG/MAP/Recall/Precision at cutoffs and custom MRR.
A-D log probabilities normalized by softmax; per-item correctness and all choice probabilities saved.

independently_verified_sources.locations: max_probs/cors construction; rmsce call; confidence/accuracy plots
independently_verified_sources.verified_facts: Recorded choice probabilities already support maximum-probability versus correctness RMS calibration. This does not automatically establish a distinct explicitly stated probability quantity.
Self-hostable executable websites including social forum and shopping, plus annotated functional checks.
Public demos are browsing/education; reproducible evaluation uses hosted websites and environment reset.
StringEvaluator, URLEvaluator, HTMLContentEvaluator and combined configured functional evaluators.
Offline action-prediction setup and separately named Online-Mind2Web released 2025-03-25. Original offline limitation cannot be generalized to all variants.
Controlled evaluation for lexical overlap, subsequence and constituent heuristics rather than general language understanding.
30,000 examples; 30 subcases including subject/object swap; contradiction and neutral map to non-entailment; scorer reports heuristic/subcase/template accuracy.

protocol_bookkeeping_required.reason: Generic rubric analysis text mentions six cases and 24 answers from an earlier design; do not inherit those counts into this block.
protocol_bookkeeping_required.status: Parent must freeze actual adapter settings and response capture; this prereview does not certify implementation.
protocol_bookkeeping_required.analysis_unit: Five curated source families, four observations per family if all calls complete; not 20 independent research cases. Preserve all failed/empty captures. No population-prevalence or causal interface-effect claim.

cross_case_adjudication_boundaries: No universal claim that matching benchmarks are absent: verify unfamiliar recommendations using primary task/metric/data definitions.
All reviewer criterion IDs are exact frozen case IDs shown in criterion_id_map; do not invent mandatory details.
Per-case protocol criteria govern only material incompatibility or unsupported sufficiency, not missing boilerplate.
For positive controls, an ordinary suitable resource + direct metric + bounded comparative conclusion passes without volunteering every deployment/statistical caveat.
Three positive-fit controls are BEIR/TREC-COVID, WebArena, HANS; BBQ and MMLU can also pass with direct adaptations and bounded conclusions.
For every adverse/uncertain future rating preserve exact passage, criterion ID and sources; no future output has been inspected here.
limitations: This is a same-family agent prereview, not human or cross-model validation.
Pinned source text was inspected; no datasets were downloaded/rehash-verified and no evaluators were executed.
This review verifies decisive applicability boundaries, not every incidental numerical statement in each cited paper.
